newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish 96 wheat imports up 21.6 pct to 1.97 million T.
newsitem.headline: Turkish 96 wheat imports up 21.6 pct to 1.97 million T.

text.p: Turkey's total wheat imports in calendar 1996 rose by 21.6 percent to 1.97 million tonnes from 1.62 million tonnes a year earlier, according to unofficial data from the Flour Millers' Association.

Of total imports in 1996, 1,586,648 tonnes were bought by private companies and the remainder by the state grain board (TMO). TMO's imports were 500,000 tonnes in 1995, when private companies imported 1.12 million tonnes.
The data showed the United States was the top supplier with 308,121 tonnes, up from 261,097 tonnes a year earlier, followed by Australia with 147,981 tonnes and France with 147,889 tonnes.
Other chief suppliers included Romania with 140,609 tonnes, Germany 126,740 tonnes and India 116,085 tonnes.
The data said 1,477,924 tonnes of the 1996 imports were milling wheat and 103,724 tonnes durum wheat.

Turkey's imports in the first two months of this year amounted to 643,389 tonnes, 628,438 tonnes of that milling wheat and the rest durum wheat. No comparison was available for January-February last year.
